about: Web ⇄ app parity manifest (docs/design/web-planner.md §14). mirrors = app logic the web re-implements (TS or a Kotlin stand-in): CI fails when the app file changed since the mirror was last checked. shared = app files the engine compiles as they are (appFiles + strings + BRouter jars and profiles): changes reach the web by merging main; listed as warnings, perf- / memory-relevant lines called out. watch = app files with plan behaviour the web neither compiles nor mirrors: changes are listed. After checking a change: node web/parity/check.mjs --update (or --update <app path> …).

mirrors.what: SacScale – T1–T5 rows (names and descriptions are the app's strings routes_sac_<n>_name / _text)
stopLabel; FirstPointMenu / PointMenu / PoiMenu look
noRouteLine texts (Hold → Click)
DEBOUNCE_MS, offline-then-online flow
place card actions (Add to route, As start, As destination, Google)
dropIndex / shift (Points drag, per pointer move)
saveMode (OVERWRITE / NEW_ROUTE: Save at once, "wie Word") – the names are shared now (routing/PlanNames.kt, engine planNewRouteName / planCopyName)
gpsColor; scale + short credit
GpsStatus names (engine stand-in recording/GpsStatus.kt)
POI filters, contour / hill-shade visibility
addDirectionArrows / arrowBitmap; app layer order
MAP_CREDITS (About)
strip: sources without a file left out with their layers
withOverview (overview merge + strip) for the cells' style
z10 cell of a tile (one owner per tile)
gradient colours of the profile
longRouteText, LongRouteDialog (Cancel / Plan anyway, no outside dismiss)
recalc long-route ask / answerLongRoute / cancelRun; importGpx, importedNote, planFromShown; withModelTime; addPlace; requestSave; suggestName
TrackPanel (shown / imported track)
Points list rows, ✕, drag – the row texts are shared now (PlanPoints.roleText / legText via Engine.rows)
problem log calls (engine stand-in)
own RoutingException texts shown, else the plain sentence (engine stand-in)
data folder layout (engine stand-in)
Txt.s / Txt.p (engine stand-in)
unescape + %N$s format (generateStrings, Txt.format)
PaceSection – Your pace: one level for hiking, one for cycling, five levels with their meaning (web: section of the activity drop-down)
Activity.navName ("Cycling · Trekking bike")
pace keys hikePaceLevel / bikePaceLevel, unknown → Pace.of (web: localStorage onpath.<key>)
multiPolygon – the packages' boxes put into the labels' within filter at runtime (merge itself runs at build time, OverviewStyle.kt)
region packages: a z7 package owns the tiles z7–9 under it (base, overlays, hillshade = region-shade); cells z10+
CellCards.build / name / rowState – the map-area strip (title, rows, more, failed, offline)
T1 point set (more than 3 new = loaded plan → T4 only), T2 search result, T3 position, T4 route corridor – web triggers (the map resting orders nothing, A-011)
Format.number / Format.distance – numbers the page writes itself (leg distances, profile axis): decimal comma in German
SETTLE_MS and "not after a map gesture" – the rules are shared now (routing/RouteFit, engine routeFirst / routeFitAfterPlace)

map style (the web copies the generated style)
